name: Crimson Nequam
source:
In Crimson Nequam, you follow Thomas, a seemingly ordinary man who stumbles into the grip of a bizarre cult known as The Cult of The Divine Wheel led by the mysterious and charismatic Paracelsus. Trapped within the cult's underground compound, Thomas must navigate twisted ideologies, dangerous rituals, and a network of sinister followers. 

The cult believes that embracing sin is the only path to enlightenment, but as Thomas is drawn deeper into their world, it becomes clear that things are far darker than they seem.

[From [url=https://kandomusic.itch.io/crimson-nequam]Itch.io[/url]]
